notes: PrefLib file 00019-00000002.toi (dataset 00019, 'oakland'). Counting rule, as far as we know: Instant runoff, single-winner. 361 ballots with two or more candidates tied at one rank were left out (not counted as blank). A 'Write-In' candidate stands for all write-in votes combined.

slates.name: Quan-Kaplan second-choice pact
slates.source: SFist, 11 Nov 2010 (https://sfist.com/2010/11/11/jean_quan_is_oaklands_first_female.php): Quan's "pact with opponent and fellow Councilwoman Rebecca Kaplan" to tell supporters "to list each other as second or third choices".

label_sources.max_ranks: Wikipedia: "Each voter could mark which candidates were the voter's first, second, and third choice."
